gloss: edge of the sumo ring; the brink

definitions.explanation: The rim of the sumo ring, where a wrestler is about to be pushed or thrown out.
A position where one more setback means defeat or failure; the very last moment before a decisive outcome.

examples.japanese: {土俵際|どひょうぎわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{粘|ねば}る→粘る：08994_nebaru⟧。
examples.english: To hang on at the edge of the ring.

examples.english: The wrestler held his ground at the edge of the ring.
